rows.location: L08.html lines 78-85 and the eight-index list; atlas/A15.contract.md lines 145-156
rows.evidence: All eight definitions match the contract text: DSRI; GMI = GM_{t-1}/GM_t; AQI = a_t/a_{t-1} with a_s = 1-(CA_s+PPE_s)/TA_s; SGI; DEPI; SGAI; LVGI = ((CL_t+LTD_t)/TA_t)/(same at t-1); TATA = (NI_t-CFO_t)/TA_t. Recomputed in recompute.py.

Bayes' rule and the law of total probability are both stated and proved on the page (definition of conditional probability applied twice; two-event partition). PPV = ps/(ps+(1-p)(1-sigma)) follows. recompute.py: all nine base-rate PPVs and flag counts reproduce from the formula with exact fractions. Example 0.005/0.0545 = 10/109 = 0.0917.
Under independence: AND = f1 f2 = 0.005; OR = 1-(1-f1)(1-f2) = 29/200 = 0.1450 for f1 = 0.10, f2 = 0.05. Proof correct for independence among non-manipulators.
Proof valid without independence: P(F1 and F2 | D) <= min, P(F1 or F2 | D) >= max. Checked on a joint law with b in [0, min(f1, f2)].

recompute.py: exact indices DSRI 3/2, GMI 8/7, AQI 13/12, SGI 6/5, DEPI 12/11, SGAI 1, LVGI 47/48, TATA 1/30. M with the page's candidate constants and TATA 4.679 = -1.5593 (recomputed).
